ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.curves.FxShiftScenario

Generates the Cross Currency curves for the definitions provided

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.curves.FxShiftScenario.

Syntax

FxShiftScenario(
    *,
    fx_curve_shift: ShiftDefinition | None = None,
    par_rate_shift: ParRateShift | None = None,
    shift_tag: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
fx_curve_shift ShiftDefinition | None No None Collection of shift parameters tenor. "all" selector supported as well.
par_rate_shift ParRateShift | None No None Scenario of par rates shift (shift applied to constituents).
shift_tag OptStr No None User defined string to identify the shift scenario tag. it can be used to link output curve to the shift scenario. only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported. optional.

Properties

Property Description
fx_curve_shift Collection of shift parameters tenor. "all" selector supported as well.
par_rate_shift Scenario of par rates shift (shift applied to constituents).
shift_tag User defined string to identify the shift scenario tag. it can be used to link output curve to the shift scenario. only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported. optional.
